source_note: Labour Code of the Republic of Armenia. Article on the consequence of continuing work after a fixed-term contract ends is not yet identified: a lawyer must supply it.
basis: owner QA O-1: contract ran out while the employee kept working; legal consequence to be confirmed by a lawyer

title.hy: Որոշակի ժամկետով պայմանագիրն ավարտվել է, աշխատողը շարունակում է աշխատել
title.ru: Срочный трудовой договор истёк, сотрудник продолжает работать
title.en: Fixed-term contract has ended, employee is still working

edge_cases: Legal consequence of continuing work after the end date needs lawyer review; no article is cited until then.
A later contract for the same employee (starting on or after the end date, or open-ended and active) counts as a successor and silences the rule.
